question: Which additional types are included in the enumeration addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: The lord of gods is addressed.
One type is the triple-staff bearer.
Another type is the seller of the Veda.
inference: The enumeration further includes the triple-staff bearer and the seller of the Veda.
plain_english: O Lord of gods, there is also the triple-staff bearer, and likewise another, the seller of the Veda.
